_comment: Playing the Pipes control tuning, read by encoder_bridge.py (pipes_control.py). Values come from the Max patch it replaces (Lamplight2026.maxpat); see ShowControl/PlayingThePipes/README.md. Times in seconds, levels in dB unless named otherwise.

velocity._comment: Detents per second, smoothed y = alpha*v + (1-alpha)*y every tick; |y| clipped to max_detents_per_s, which is 'fast' in the voice ranges below.

wake._comment: A knob wakes on its first detent and sleeps after sleep_after_s without one; its level fades over fade_s each way.

position._comment: Detents since wake, clipped to +-range_detents, mapped linearly to out_min..out_max of the grain buffer.

_voices_comment: Grain voice per encoder: [at rest, at max velocity], linear in |velocity|. grain_size_ms is also the grain period, so grains per second = 1000 / grain_size_ms * grain_probability. spray_ms is the Max patch's delayRandom. Level = level_scale * fade * volume^2.
_knob_voice_comment: Knob N (= board*6 + enc) plays voices[knob_voice[N]]: board 1 mirrors board 0.

mix._comment: A knob counts as active for active_for_s after its last detent. target = floor(min(max_state, per_active_knob * active knobs)); a new, higher target raises the state; the state then steps down by 1 every step_down_s to 0. Each state change crossfades the 13 loop levels to presets_db[state] over crossfade_s, linear in dB. floor_db and below is silence.

send._comment: Each OSC value is sent when it moves by more than epsilon, at most every min_interval_s; every value is re-sent every refresh_s so a restarted reuben catches up.
